seed: Start from the transitions where an action produced no change at all. Find what blocked the action in each case and write the blocking condition before the movement rule.

synth.notes:
Blocking first: a player step (3 cells) is a no-op if its next rect leaves the portal bbox or covers a frame colour outside {1,4} (t2/t3 no-ops).
Kick: stepping into a block slides the overlapped chain 1 cell/tick over {1,4,15}, absorbing hit blocks, until wall/bound/player/non-fitting socket interior.
Click on a block: player takes its rect; old player stays as inert husk (14 ring, centre 4); vacated cells revert to socket rim 4/interior 1 or nearest-neighbour majority.
HUD row 63: (n+1)//2 zeros from right, n = actions this level, carried only on exact frame continuity (fallback 2z-1).
Unconfirmed: fitting-socket completion, player touching husk, actions 2/5/7.
